en.title: Forza Horizon 6 Lands Xbox Ultimate Game of the Year Nomination
en.summary: The Golden Joystick Awards 2026 nominations are in, and Xbox has secured a spot in the prestigious Ultimate Game of the Year category. Forza Horizon 6 is the title carrying the Xbox banner into the awards.
en.body:
Awards season is gearing up, and the **Golden Joystick Awards 2026** have officially revealed their final nominations for Ultimate Game of the Year. Representing the Xbox ecosystem is none other than **Forza Horizon 6**, a title that roared onto the scene back in May. This prestigious nomination places the flagship racing series in contention against eleven other remarkable games, a testament to its impact and quality.

While **Forza Horizon 6** is the sole Xbox title vying for the ultimate prize this year, it's worth noting that other major Xbox releases like **Halo: Campaign Evolved** and the highly anticipated **Gears of War: E-Day** did not make the final cut for this specific category. Despite the latter being eligible, it ultimately didn't secure a spot among the nominees. The full list of contenders showcases a broad spectrum of gaming experiences, including **007 First Light**, **Big Walk**, **CONTROL Resonant**, **Crimson Desert**, **Dispatch**, **Phantom Blade Zero**, **Pokémon Pokopia**, **PRAGMATA**, **Resident Evil Requiem**, **STAR WARS: Galactic Racer**, and **The Blood of Dawnwalker**. The sheer variety on display underscores the incredibly competitive nature of the gaming landscape in 2026.

## Fan Engagement and the Road to Victory

For dedicated fans of **Forza Horizon 6** and Xbox in general, this nomination is a significant moment. It provides a clear opportunity to rally behind a title that has clearly resonated with critics and players alike. The **Golden Joystick Awards** have always been heavily influenced by public vote, making community engagement absolutely crucial. The sheer breadth of genres represented in the nominations means that fans will need to actively cast their votes to ensure their favorites have the best chance of winning. It’s a chance for the passionate **Forza** community to show their appreciation for the open-world driving experience that has become a staple for Xbox players worldwide.

## What's Next

Voting for the Ultimate Game of the Year and all other **Golden Joystick Awards 2026** categories is now open and will close on October 30th. The winners will be announced during a special livestreamed ceremony broadcasting live from London on November 11th. Fans can tune in to see if **Forza Horizon 6** can drive away with the coveted Game of the Year trophy.
